app.name: Alumex
app.subtitle: Quotation System
app.title: Alumex Quotation System
app.description: UI for Alumex quotations, projects, clients, and contracts.

auth.loginHeadline: Quotation and contract control for Alumex teams.
auth.loginDescription: A focused workspace for clients, project pricing, contract status, and follow-up actions.
auth.demoDescription: Enter the local demo workspace for development testing.
auth.productionDescription: Sign in with your Supabase account to access the Alumex workspace.
auth.supabaseFetchError: Unable to reach Supabase. Check your Supabase URL and key, then try again.
auth.loginError: Unable to login. Check your Supabase configuration, then try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor the commercial pipeline, project handoffs, and contract activity from one workspace.
dashboard.noQuotationActivity: No saved quotations yet. Create quotations from the Quotations page or from a project details page.
dashboard.noActiveProjects: No active projects are currently available.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Create, search, edit, delete, and review client contact details before database integration.
clients.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile, province, city, email, or notes
clients.clientNotFoundDescription: This client is not available in the current local UI state.
clients.detailsDescription: Review and update the complete client contact profile.
clients.noClientsDescription: Adjust the search term or create a new client.
clients.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? This only removes it from the current UI state.
clients.validationRequired: Client name, phone number, and address are required.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Create, update, search, filter, and review project records before database integration.
projects.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, name, client, type, engineer, address, or status
projects.projectNotFoundDescription: This project is not available in the current local UI state.
projects.detailsDescription: Review project scope, status, and structural openings.
projects.noProjectsDescription: Adjust the search or status filter, or create a new project.
projects.validationRequired: Client, project name, address, project type, and status are required.

openings.title: Structural Openings
openings.description: Add, edit, duplicate, and price project openings before quotation generation.
openings.addOpeningBeforeQuotation: Add at least one opening before generating a quotation.
openings.noOpeningsDescription: Add the first opening to start building a quotation.
openings.minimumAreaNote: Openings below 1 sqm are billed as 1 sqm.
openings.areaRule: Area uses Width (cm) / 100 × Height (cm) / 100 × Quantity, with a 1 sqm minimum per opening.
openings.caption: Structural openings
openings.validationRequired: Opening code, width, height, quantity, product system, glass type, and aluminum color are required.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.description: Generate quotation previews from project structural openings with unit prices and discounts.
quotations.builderDescription: Generate quotation totals from project structural openings, unit prices, and discounts.
quotations.prerequisitesTitle: Quotation creation needs a complete local project setup.
quotations.noClientsPrerequisite: Create a client first, then create a project for that client.
quotations.noProjectsPrerequisite: Create a project first, then add structural openings from the project details page.
quotations.noOpeningsPrerequisite: Add at least one structural opening to a project before creating a quotation.
quotations.validationRequired: Select a project with at least one opening before generating a quotation.
quotations.noOpeningsLoadedDescription: Select a project that has structural openings.
quotations.coverDescription: Executive quotation package for aluminum and glass systems, prepared for review and approval.
quotations.noPreviewDescription: Create a quotation from the builder first.
quotations.defaultNotes: Prices are valid for 15 days from quotation date. Final measurements are subject to site verification.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Generate browser contract previews with cover pages, Arabic RTL support, and signature pages.
contracts.generatorDescription: Generate an Alumex contract preview from project and opening data.
contracts.coverDescription: Executive contract cover summarizing the project, client, commercial value, and preparation details for approval.
contracts.scopeDescription: Alumex shall supply and execute the aluminum and glass product systems for the project listed above according to approved specifications and quantities.
contracts.noSavedQuotationsDescription: Generate and save a quotation before creating a contract.
contracts.previewDescription: The browser preview supports Arabic RTL, print styling, and PDF generation.
contracts.noPreviewDescription: Create a contract from the generator first.
contracts.defaultPaymentTerms: 40% advance payment, 50% upon material delivery, 10% after installation completion.
contracts.defaultWarrantyTerms: Alumex provides warranty coverage for supplied aluminum systems according to approved specifications and normal use conditions.
contracts.defaultExecutionTerms: Execution schedule starts after advance payment, approved drawings, and confirmed site readiness.
contracts.defaultNotes: Any additional works, site changes, or revised quantities require written approval before execution.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preview the configuration areas for company details, numbering, currency, and reminders.
settings.usersDescription: Manage real user access for the Alumex workspace.
settings.serviceRoleMissing: Server admin key is missing. Add SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to enable user management.
settings.emailRequired: Email and temporary password are required.
